verdict.rationale: Capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question for Datadog's LLM/Agent Observability tracing product, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers SDK instrumentation, auto-instrumentation and viewing span inputs and outputs. Nothing documents capturing images, audio or files inside spans.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
